sebb5aff92a0178: Soft cuttings become really feasible and depend on the evolution of technological conditions. Communities have experienced three key changes: first, the CanN Open Source, where communities are beginning to be prepared to support Ascend sharing; but at the experimental validation stage, it was found that equipment did not support and deploy the desired multi-processes; and only when the drive for upgrading supported multi-processes would the basis for sharing truly mature.
sfce53b8c78aea6: There was also a record-based "back-to-back" attempt — China's open source Flex:AI. Its goal was to share Ascend NPU, but to achieve the equipment constraints that were then: remote calls for assembly requests, and the NPU side actually kept single processes in place. It proved that sharing could be done at the entrance level, but it remained multi-processed on the side of the device, with deployment links becoming more complex. The real breakthrough was until the device itself supported multiple processes and issued.

s965a49f50522f8: V. The future outlook: experience with improved and dynamic governance
sb42a3dbf134a3f: Future prospects: moving from static to dynamic governance - Profiling, compute resources, overselling of resources
s5c064f6118c3f6: Figure 9: Future prospects: moving from static to dynamic governance - Profiling, compute resources, overselling of resources
se9e1c2726e6e6f: Finally, Wang Qi talks about two directions. In the short term, experience is improved: to have hard-cut and soft-sliced tasks managed centrally, task assignments distributed on a needs basis and with no sense of the upper layer; to support the visible distribution results within containers, complete container level GPS monitoring; to update the enhanced compatible matrix of volcano Ascend device-plugin simultaneously; and to optimize the values configuration, fill up false logs, so that users of common problems can sort out themselves.
s0952964704f5a9: Further step forward is to move from static cut-offs to dynamic governance: through Profiling, GPU memory, Compute resources and time-frame features, to understand loads and identify intermission disruptions; after resource boundaries are controlled and in a state of visibility, compute resources capture (dynamic recovery or compression of lower priority levels when high priority tasks come, while controlling recovery costs and end extensions) and oversale of resources (share surplus based on real use rather than static applications to avoid loss of control), thereby understanding the overall rate of loads, dynamic adjustments and improvements.
sc5777291f6fa36: From claud-native to AI, businesses need more than just more compute resources and an infrastructure that can be managed centrally, shared flexibly, and managed continuously. The longer-term value of Hami vNPU is the fact that it has evolved from hard to soft, as well as from production in China Mercantants Bank, which is a solid advance on this road — while real demand continues to feed the community, allowing recruitment to grow from user to co-builder.
